title.zh: 卷295 列傳八十二 隆科多 年羹尧 年希尧 胡期恒
title.en: Volume 295 Biographies 82: Long Keduo, Nian Geng Yao, Nian Xi Yao, Hu Qiheng
title.raw: 卷295 列傳八十二 隆科多 年羹尧 年希尧 胡期恒

sentences.zh: 隆科多，佟佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，一等公佟國維子，孝懿仁皇后弟也。

translations.literal: Long Keduo, of the Tungiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner, son of the duke of the first rank Tong Guowei, and younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren.
translations.idiomatic: Long Keduo, of the Tungiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner—the son of Duke Tong Guowei of the first rank and younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十七年，授一等侍衛，擢鑾儀使，兼正藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Kangxi, he was appointed a first-class bodyguard, promoted to Director of the Imperial Procession Guard, and concurrently made Deputy Lieutenant General of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 27 (1688), he was appointed a first-class bodyguard, promoted to Director of the Imperial Procession Guard, and concurrently made Deputy Lieutenant General of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，以所屬人違法，上責隆科多不實心任事，罷副都統、鑾儀使，在一等侍衛上行走。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, because subordinates had violated the law, the emperor blamed Long Keduo for not serving wholeheartedly, dismissed him from the posts of Deputy Lieutenant General and Director of the Imperial Procession Guard, and ordered him to serve as a first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-four, when subordinates under his command broke the law, the emperor faulted Long Keduo for lack of diligence, stripped him of his posts as Deputy Lieutenant General and Director of the Imperial Procession Guard, and left him serving only as a first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 五十年，授步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, he was appointed Commander of the Metropolitan Banner Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty, he was appointed Commander of the Metropolitan Banner Brigade.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，擢理籓院尚書，仍管步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, he was promoted to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs while still retaining charge of the Metropolitan Banner Brigade.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-nine he was promoted to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs while continuing to command the Metropolitan Banner Brigade.

sentences.zh: 六十一年十一月，聖祖大漸，召受顧命。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixty-first year, when the Sacred Ancestor was gravely ill, Long Keduo was summoned to receive the imperial testament.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Kangxi 61, as the Kangxi Emperor lay dying, Long Keduo was summoned to receive the dying emperor's testament.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，命與大學士馬齊總理事務，襲一等公，授吏部尚書。

translations.literal: When the Yongzheng Emperor acceded, he was ordered together with Grand Secretary Ma Qi to oversee affairs of state, inherited the dukedom of the first rank, and was appointed Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongzheng Emperor took the throne, Long Keduo was ordered to oversee state affairs jointly with Grand Secretary Ma Qi, inherited the dukedom of the first rank, and was appointed Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 旋以總理事務勞，加一等阿達哈哈番，以其長子岳興阿襲。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, for his labors in overseeing affairs, he was granted an additional ada hahaan of the first class, which his eldest son Yuexing'a inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, in recognition of his service in overseeing state affairs, he received an additional hereditary rank of ada hahaan of the first class, which passed to his eldest son Yuexing'a.

sentences.zh: 次子玉柱，自侍衛授鑾儀使。

translations.literal: His second son Yuzhu, formerly a bodyguard, was appointed Director of the Imperial Procession Guard.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Yuzhu was promoted from bodyguard to Director of the Imperial Procession Guard.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，與川陝總督年羹堯同加太保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, he and Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Nian Gengyao were both promoted to Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1, he and Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Nian Gengyao were both made Grand Tutors.

sentences.zh: 二年，兼領理籓院事。

translations.literal: In the second year, he additionally took charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year two he additionally took charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 纂修《聖祖實錄》、《大清會典》並充總裁，監修《明史》。

translations.literal: He compiled the Veritable Records of the Sacred Ancestor and the Great Qing Statutes and served as chief editor, and supervised the compilation of the History of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: He served as chief editor for the Veritable Records of the Kangxi Emperor and the Great Qing Statutes, and supervised the compilation of the History of the Ming.

sentences.zh: 復與羹堯同賜雙眼花翎、四團龍補服、黃帶、紫轡。

translations.literal: Again together with Gengyao he was granted the double-eyed peacock feather, the four-claw dragon rank robe, the yellow belt, and the purple bridle.
translations.idiomatic: He and Gengyao were again granted the same extraordinary honors: the double-eyed peacock feather, the four-claw dragon rank robe, the yellow belt, and the purple bridle.

sentences.zh: 三年，解步軍統領。

translations.literal: In the third year, he was relieved of the Metropolitan Banner Brigade command.
translations.idiomatic: In year three he was relieved of command of the Metropolitan Banner Brigade.

sentences.zh: 玉柱以行止甚劣，奪官，交隆科多管束。

translations.literal: Yuzhu, for extremely improper conduct, was stripped of office and placed under Long Keduo's discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhu was stripped of office for gross misconduct and placed under Long Keduo's supervision.

sentences.zh: 羹堯得罪，上以都統範時捷疏劾欺罔貪婪諸狀，及妄劾道員金南瑛等，並下吏部議處。

translations.literal: When Gengyao fell from favor, the emperor, on the basis of a memorial from Banner Commander Fan Shijie impeaching him for deception, greed, and other offenses, as well as for falsely impeaching Circuit Intendant Jin Nanying and others, ordered the Ministry of Personnel to deliberate on punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian Gengyao fell from favor, the emperor acted on a memorial from Banner Commander Fan Shijie charging him with deception, greed, and other offenses, including false impeachment of Circuit Intendant Jin Nanying and others, and referred the case to the Ministry of Personnel for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「前以隆科多、年羹堯頗著勤勞，予以異數，乃交結專擅，諸事欺隱。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Previously, because Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao had shown considerable merit, extraordinary favors were granted them, yet they formed factions and monopolized power, concealing and deceiving in all matters.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor declared: "Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao once earned extraordinary favor for their distinguished service, yet they formed factions, monopolized power, and concealed the truth in one matter after another.

sentences.zh: 」命繳上所賜四團龍補服，並不得復用雙眼花翎、黃帶、紫轡。

translations.literal: " He ordered them to surrender the four-claw dragon rank robes bestowed by the throne, and forbade them ever again to use the double-eyed peacock feather, yellow belt, or purple bridle.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered them to surrender the four-claw dragon robes the throne had bestowed and permanently barred them from the double-eyed peacock feather, yellow belt, and purple bridle.

sentences.zh: 及議上，以時捷劾，請罷羹堯任；

translations.literal: When the deliberation was submitted, on the basis of Shijie's impeachment it recommended dismissing Gengyao from office;
translations.idiomatic: When the ministry's recommendation came up, it cited Shijie's charges and proposed removing Gengyao from office;

sentences.zh: 以妄劾南瑛，請嚴加治罪。

translations.literal: for the false impeachment of Nanying, it recommended severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: and for the false impeachment of Nanying, it proposed severe punishment.

sentences.zh: 上以前議徇庇，後議復過當，責隆科多有意擾亂，削太保及一等阿達哈哈番世職，命往阿蘭善等處修城墾地，諭曰：「朕御極之初，隆科多、年羹堯皆寄以心腹，毫無猜防。

translations.literal: The emperor, holding that the earlier recommendation showed favoritism and the later one was again excessive, blamed Long Keduo for deliberately causing disorder, stripped him of the Grand Tutorship and the hereditary ada hahaan of the first class, and ordered him to go to Alashan and other places to build fortifications and open land. He instructed: "At the beginning of my reign, Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao were both entrusted as my closest confidants, without the slightest suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: Finding the earlier recommendation too lenient and the later one excessive, the emperor blamed Long Keduo for deliberately sowing confusion, stripped him of the Grand Tutorship and the hereditary ada hahaan rank, and sent him to Alashan and elsewhere to build fortifications and reclaim land. He declared: "At the start of my reign I entrusted Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao as my closest confidants, without a trace of suspicion.

sentences.zh: 孰知朕視為一德，彼竟有二心，招權納賄，擅作威福，欺罔悖負，朕豈能姑息養奸耶？

translations.literal: Who would have known that while I regarded them as of one mind, they harbored divided hearts, solicited power and accepted bribes, arrogated authority and bestowed favors, deceived and betrayed—how could I indulge and nurture such villains?
translations.idiomatic: Yet while I treated them as men of one heart, they nursed divided loyalties—soliciting power, taking bribes, arrogating authority, and deceiving the throne. How could I indulge such villains?

sentences.zh: 向日明珠、索額圖結黨行私，聖祖解其要職，置之閒散，何嘗更加信用？

translations.literal: In former days, when Songgotu and Sonin formed factions for private gain, the Sacred Ancestor removed them from key posts and placed them in idle positions—when did he ever trust them again?
translations.idiomatic: When Songgotu and Sonin once formed factions for private gain, the Kangxi Emperor removed them from key posts and set them aside—did he ever trust them again?

sentences.zh: 隆科多、年羹堯若不知恐懼，痛改前非，欲如明珠等，萬不能也！

translations.literal: If Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao do not know fear and thoroughly reform their past errors, to hope for treatment like Mingzhu and the others is utterly impossible!
translations.idiomatic: If Long Keduo and Nian Gengyao do not learn fear and thoroughly reform, they must not imagine they can fare like Songgotu and Sonin!

sentences.zh: 殊典不可再邀，覆轍不可屢蹈，各宜警懼，毋自乾誅滅。

translations.literal: Extraordinary favors cannot be sought again; repeated falls into the same pit cannot be tolerated—each should be vigilant and fearful, and not bring destruction upon himself.
translations.idiomatic: Extraordinary favor will not be granted twice; the same pit must not be fallen into again. Let each take warning and not court his own destruction.

sentences.zh: 四年，隆科多家僕牛倫挾勢索賕，事發，逮下法司，鞫得隆科多受羹堯及總督趙世顯、滿保，巡撫甘國璧、蘇克濟賄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Long Keduo's household servant Niulun, abusing his master's power, extorted bribes; when the matter came to light he was arrested and handed to the judicial authorities, and investigation revealed that Long Keduo had accepted bribes from Gengyao and from Governors Zhao Shixian and Manbao, and from Governors-General Gan Guobi and Sukeji.
translations.idiomatic: In year four, Long Keduo's servant Niulun was caught extorting bribes by abusing his master's power. Handed to the courts, the case revealed that Long Keduo had taken bribes from Gengyao, Governors Zhao Shixian and Manbao, and Governors-General Gan Guobi and Sukeji.

sentences.zh: 讞上，上命斬倫，罷隆科多尚書，令料理阿爾泰等路邊疆事務。

translations.literal: When the verdict was submitted, the emperor ordered Niulun beheaded, dismissed Long Keduo from the Ministry of Personnel, and ordered him to manage frontier affairs along the Altai and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: When the verdict came up, the emperor ordered Niulun executed, removed Long Keduo from the Ministry of Personnel, and assigned him to manage frontier affairs along the Altai routes.

sentences.zh: 尋命勘議俄羅斯邊界。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered to survey and deliberate on the Russian border.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered to survey and negotiate the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 初，隆科多與阿靈阿、揆敘相黨附，繼又與羹堯交結。

translations.literal: Earlier, Long Keduo had attached himself to the faction of Aling'a and Kuisu, and afterward also formed ties with Gengyao.
translations.idiomatic: Long Keduo had first aligned with Aling'a and Kuisu, and later formed ties with Gengyao as well.

sentences.zh: 至是，上盡發阿靈阿、揆敘及羹堯罪狀，宣示中外。

translations.literal: At this point the emperor fully disclosed the crimes of Aling'a, Kuisu, and Gengyao and proclaimed them within and beyond the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor now fully disclosed the crimes of Aling'a, Kuisu, and Gengyao and proclaimed them at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 又侍郎查嗣庭為隆科多所薦，坐悖逆誅死，上詰隆科多，隆科多不以實對。

translations.literal: Moreover, Vice Minister Zha Siting, whom Long Keduo had recommended, was executed for treason; the emperor questioned Long Keduo, and Long Keduo did not answer truthfully.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zha Siting, whom Long Keduo had recommended, was executed for treason; when the emperor questioned Long Keduo, he did not answer truthfully.

sentences.zh: 五年，宗人府復奏劾輔國公阿布蘭以玉牒畀隆科多藏於家，阿布蘭坐奪爵幽禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Court of the Imperial Clan again memorialized impeaching Assistant Duke Ablan for giving the imperial genealogy to Long Keduo to keep in his house; Ablan was stripped of his rank and placed under house arrest.
translations.idiomatic: In year five the Court of the Imperial Clan reported that Assistant Duke Ablan had given the imperial genealogy to Long Keduo to keep at home; Ablan was stripped of his rank and confined.

sentences.zh: 上命奪隆科多爵，召還京，命王大臣會鞫。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Long Keduo's noble rank stripped, summoned him back to the capital, and ordered princes and grand ministers jointly to try him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped Long Keduo of his noble rank, recalled him to the capital, and ordered a joint trial by princes and grand ministers.

sentences.zh: 以聖祖升遐，隆科多未在上前，妄言身藏匕首以防不測；

translations.literal: Because at the Sacred Ancestor's passing Long Keduo had not been before the emperor, he falsely claimed he carried a dagger on his person against unforeseen danger;
translations.idiomatic: At the Kangxi Emperor's death Long Keduo had not been at the emperor's side, yet falsely claimed he had carried a dagger against unforeseen danger;

sentences.zh: 又自擬諸葛亮，奏稱「白帝城受命之日，即死期將至之時」；

translations.literal: he also compared himself to Zhuge Liang, memorializing that "the day of receiving the mandate at Baidicheng is the day when death draws near";
translations.idiomatic: he compared himself to Zhuge Liang, writing that "the day of receiving the mandate at Baidicheng is the day when death draws near";

sentences.zh: 上躬祀壇廟，妄謂防刺客，令於案下搜查；

translations.literal: when the emperor personally sacrificed at the altars and temples, he falsely spoke of guarding against assassins and ordered searches beneath the altar tables;
translations.idiomatic: when the emperor sacrificed at the altars and temples, he falsely spoke of guarding against assassins and ordered searches beneath the altar tables;

sentences.zh: 上謁陵，妄奏「諸王心變」。

translations.literal: when the emperor visited the imperial tombs, he falsely memorialized that "the princes' hearts have changed."
translations.idiomatic: and when the emperor visited the imperial tombs, he falsely reported that "the princes' hearts have turned."

sentences.zh: 具獄辭：大不敬之罪五，欺罔之罪四，紊亂朝政之罪三，黨姦之罪六，不法之罪七，貪婪之罪十六，凡四十一款，當斬，妻子入辛者庫，財產入官。

translations.literal: The completed indictment listed: five counts of gross disrespect, four of deception, three of disordering court governance, six of factional villainy, seven of lawlessness, and sixteen of greed—forty-one articles in all. The penalty was decapitation; wife and children to enter the Sinchu Treasury; property to be confiscated by the state.
translations.idiomatic: The completed indictment listed forty-one counts: five of gross disrespect, four of deception, three of disordering the court, six of factional villainy, seven of lawlessness, and sixteen of greed. The sentence was decapitation; his wife and children were to enter bondage in the Sinchu Treasury and his property was to be confiscated.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「隆科多罪不容誅，但皇考升遐，大臣承旨者惟隆科多一人。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Long Keduo's crimes merit execution, yet at my late father's passing the minister who received his testament was Long Keduo alone.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor declared: "Long Keduo's crimes deserve death, yet at my father's passing he alone among the ministers received the dying testament.

sentences.zh: 今以罪誅，朕心有所不忍，可免其正法，於暢春園外築屋三楹，永遠禁錮；

translations.literal: To put him to death for his crimes now is more than my heart can bear; let formal execution be waived. Outside the Garden of Refreshing Spring build three rooms and imprison him there permanently;
translations.idiomatic: To execute him now is more than I can bear. Formal execution is waived; three rooms shall be built outside the Garden of Refreshing Spring and he shall be imprisoned there for life;

sentences.zh: 妻子免入辛者庫，岳興阿奪官，玉柱發黑龍江。

translations.literal: his wife and children are exempted from the Sinchu Treasury; Yuexing'a is stripped of office; Yuzhu is banished to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: his wife and children are spared the Sinchu Treasury; Yuexing'a is stripped of office; and Yuzhu is banished to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，隆科多死於禁所，賜金治喪。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, Long Keduo died in confinement; funds were granted for his funeral.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year six Long Keduo died in confinement; the court granted funds for his funeral.

sentences.zh: 年羹堯，字亮工，漢軍鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Nian Gengyao, style name Lianggong, was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Nian Gengyao, courtesy name Lianggong, was a Han Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 父遐齡，自筆帖式授兵部主事，再遷刑部郎中。

translations.literal: His father Xialing, from clerk of the Grand Secretariat was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of War, and after two promotions became a director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xialing rose from Grand Secretariat clerk to secretary in the Ministry of War and, after two promotions, to director in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年，授河南道御史。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi, he was appointed censor of the Henan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 22 he was appointed censor of the Henan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 四遷工部侍郎，出為湖廣巡撫。

translations.literal: After four promotions he became Vice Minister of Works, then went out as Governor of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: After four promotions he became Vice Minister of Works, then was appointed Governor of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 湖北武昌等七府歲徵匠役班價銀千餘，戶絕額缺，為官民累。

translations.literal: In Hubei, the seven prefectures including Wuchang annually levied more than a thousand taels in artisan-service quota silver; when households died out quotas went unfilled, becoming a burden on officials and people alike.
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei, seven prefectures including Wuchang annually levied more than a thousand taels in artisan-service quota silver; when households died out and quotas went unfilled, the burden fell on officials and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 遐齡請歸地丁徵收，下部議，從之。

translations.literal: Xialing requested that collection be folded into the land-and-poll tax; the ministry deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: Xialing proposed folding the levy into the land-and-poll tax; the ministry approved.

sentences.zh: 疏劾黃梅知縣李錦虧賦，奪官。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Li Jin, magistrate of Huangmei, for tax shortfalls, and Li was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized against Li Jin, magistrate of Huangmei, for tax shortfalls, and Li was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 錦清廉得民，民爭完逋賦，諸生吳士光等聚眾閉城留錦。

translations.literal: Li was upright and had won the people's affection; the people competed to pay arrears in full, and licentiate Wu Shiguang and others gathered a crowd, closed the city gates, and detained Li.
translations.idiomatic: Li was upright and beloved by the people, who rushed to pay tax arrears in full; licentiate Wu Shiguang and others gathered a crowd, shut the city gates, and detained him.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上命調錦直隸，士光等發奉天，遐齡與總督郭琇俱降級留任。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor ordered Li transferred to Zhili, Wu Shiguang and others sent to Fengtian, and both Xialing and Governor-General Guo Xiu were demoted a grade but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, the emperor transferred Li to Zhili, sent Wu Shiguang and his followers to Fengtian, and demoted both Xialing and Governor-General Guo Xiu one grade while retaining them in office.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，遐齡以病乞休。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, Xialing requested retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-three Xialing retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 羹堯，康熙三十九年進士，改庶吉士，授檢討。

translations.literal: Gengyao passed the metropolitan examination in the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed reviser.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao passed the metropolitan examination in Kangxi 39, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed reviser.

sentences.zh: 迭充四川、廣東鄉試考官，累遷內閣學士。

translations.literal: He served in succession as examiner for the Sichuan and Guangdong provincial examinations and was promoted cumulatively to Hanlin Academician of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as examiner for the Sichuan and Guangdong provincial examinations and rose to Hanlin Academician of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，擢四川巡撫。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year, he was promoted to Governor of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-eight he was promoted to Governor of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，斡偉生番羅都等掠寧番衛，戕游擊周玉麟。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, the Gowei Shengfan chieftain Luodu and others raided Ningfan Guard and killed Mobile Brigade Commander Zhou Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: In year forty-nine the Gowei Shengfan chieftain Luodu and others raided Ningfan Guard and killed Mobile Brigade Commander Zhou Yulin.

sentences.zh: 上命羹堯與提督岳昇龍剿撫。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Gengyao together with Provincial Military Commander Yue Shenglong to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Gengyao and Provincial Military Commander Yue Shenglong to suppress and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 昇龍率兵討之，擒羅都，羹堯至平番衛，聞羅都已擒，引還。

translations.literal: Shenglong led troops against them and captured Luodu; Gengyao reached Pingfan Guard, heard Luodu had already been captured, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Shenglong led troops against them and captured Luodu; Gengyao reached Pingfan Guard, learned Luodu was already taken, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 川陝總督音泰疏劾，部議當奪官，上命留任。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Yintai memorialized impeaching him; the ministry recommended stripping his office, but the emperor ordered him retained.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Yintai of Sichuan-Shaanxi memorialized against him; the ministry recommended removal, but the emperor ordered him retained.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，越巂衛屬番與普雄土千戶那交等為亂，羹堯遣游擊張玉剿平之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, dependent tribes of Yuexi Guard together with Puxiong Native Official Na Jiao and others rebelled; Gengyao sent Mobile Brigade Commander Zhang Yu to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-six dependent tribes of Yuexi Guard joined Native Official Na Jiao of Puxiong and others in rebellion; Gengyao sent Mobile Brigade Commander Zhang Yu to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，策妄阿喇布坦遣其將策淩敦多卜襲西藏，戕拉藏汗。

translations.literal: That year, Tsewang Arabtan sent his general Tsewang Donduk to raid Tibet and kill the Dalai Lama's regent Lhabzang Khan.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tsewang Arabtan sent his general Tsewang Donduk to raid Tibet and kill Lhabzang Khan.

sentences.zh: 四川提督康泰率兵出黃勝關，兵譁，引還。

translations.literal: Sichuan Provincial Military Commander Kang Tai led troops out through Huangsheng Pass; the troops mutinied, and he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Provincial Military Commander Kang Tai led troops out through Huangsheng Pass, but they mutinied and he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣參將楊盡信撫諭之，密奏泰失兵心，不可用，請親赴松潘協理軍務。

translations.literal: Gengyao sent Brigade Commander Yang Jinxin to pacify them by persuasion, and secretly memorialized that Kang had lost the soldiers' hearts and was unusable, requesting to go in person to Songpan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Brigade Commander Yang Jinxin to pacify the troops and secretly reported that Kang had lost the soldiers' loyalty and was unfit for command, asking to go personally to Songpan to oversee military affairs.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其實心任事，遣都統法喇率兵赴四川助剿。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his wholehearted service and dispatched Banner Commander Fala with troops to Sichuan to assist in the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his diligence and dispatched Banner Commander Fala with troops to assist in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，羹堯令護軍統領溫普進駐里塘，增設打箭爐至里塘驛站，尋請增設四川駐防兵，皆允之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year, Gengyao ordered Garrison Commander Wenpu to advance and encamp at Litang, added courier stations from Dartsedo to Litang, and soon requested additional garrison troops in Sichuan—all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-seven Gengyao ordered Garrison Commander Wenpu to advance to Litang, added courier stations from Dartsedo to Litang, and soon won approval for additional Sichuan garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 上嘉羹堯治事明敏，巡撫無督兵責，特授四川總督，兼管巡撫事。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Gengyao's keen and efficient administration; since a governor had no responsibility to command troops, he was specially appointed Governor of Sichuan while also retaining charge of governorship affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Praising Gengyao's keen administration, the emperor noted that a governor normally had no troop command; he was therefore specially appointed Governor of Sichuan with concurrent charge of governorship affairs.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，羹堯以敵情叵測，請赴藏為備。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year, Gengyao, because the enemy's situation was unpredictable, requested to go to Tibet as a precaution.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-eight, finding the enemy situation unpredictable, Gengyao asked to go to Tibet as a precaution.

sentences.zh: 廷議以鬆潘諸路軍事重要，令羹堯毋率兵出邊，檄法喇進師。

translations.literal: Court deliberation held that military affairs along the Songpan routes were critical and ordered Gengyao not to lead troops beyond the border, dispatching Fala to advance.
translations.idiomatic: The court held that affairs along the Songpan routes were critical and ordered Gengyao not to lead troops beyond the border, dispatching Fala to advance instead.

sentences.zh: 法喇率副將岳鍾琪撫定里塘、巴塘。

translations.literal: Fala led Vice Commander Yue Zhongqi to pacify Litang and Batang.
translations.idiomatic: Fala led Vice Commander Yue Zhongqi to pacify Litang and Batang.

sentences.zh: 羹堯亦遣知府遲維德招降乍丫、察木多、察哇諸番目，因請召法喇師還，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao also sent Prefect Chi Weide to induce the chieftains of Zhaya, Chamdo, Chawa, and others to submit, and therefore requested that Fala's army be recalled—approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao also sent Prefect Chi Weide to win over the chieftains of Zhaya, Chamdo, Chawa, and others, then asked that Fala's army be recalled; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，上命平逆將軍延信率兵自青海入西藏，授羹堯定西將軍印，自拉里會師，並諮羹堯孰可署總督者。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, the emperor ordered Pacification General Yensin to lead troops into Tibet from Qinghai, granted Gengyao the seal of Pacification General of the West, to join forces at Lhari, and also consulted Gengyao on who could act as governor in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In year fifty-nine the emperor ordered Pacification General Yensin to enter Tibet from Qinghai, granted Gengyao the seal of Pacification General of the West to join forces at Lhari, and asked whom he recommended to act as governor in his absence.

sentences.zh: 羹堯言一時不得其人，請以將軍印畀護軍統領噶爾弼，而移法喇軍駐打箭爐，上用其議。

translations.literal: Gengyao said that for the moment no suitable man could be found, and requested that the general's seal be given to Garrison Commander Ga'erbi while Fala's army was moved to garrison Dartsedo; the emperor adopted his proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao said no suitable man was available at the moment and proposed giving the general's seal to Garrison Commander Ga'erbi while moving Fala's army to Dartsedo; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 巴塘、里塘本雲南麗江土府屬地，既撫定，雲貴總督蔣陳錫請仍隸麗江土知府木興；

translations.literal: Batang and Litang had originally been territory subordinate to the native prefecture of Lijiang in Yunnan; once pacified, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Jiang Chenxi requested they again be placed under Lijiang Native Prefect Mu Xing;
translations.idiomatic: Batang and Litang had originally belonged to the native prefecture of Lijiang in Yunnan; once pacified, Governor-General Jiang Chenxi of Yunnan-Guizhou asked that they again be placed under Lijiang Native Prefect Mu Xing;

sentences.zh: 羹堯言二地為入藏運糧要路，宜屬四川，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao said the two places were critical routes for transporting grain into Tibet and should belong to Sichuan; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao argued that both places lay on the vital grain route into Tibet and should belong to Sichuan; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 興率兵往收地，至喇皮，擊殺番酋巴桑，羹堯疏劾。

translations.literal: Xing led troops to recover the territory; reaching Lapi he killed the tribal chieftain Basang; Gengyao memorialized impeaching him.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Xing led troops to recover the territory and, reaching Lapi, killed tribal chieftain Basang; Gengyao memorialized against him.

sentences.zh: 上命逮興，囚雲南省城。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Xing arrested and imprisoned in the Yunnan provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Mu Xing arrested and imprisoned in the Yunnan provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 八月，噶爾弼、延信兩軍先後入西藏，策淩敦多卜敗走，西藏平。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the armies of Ga'erbi and Yensin entered Tibet in succession; Tsewang Donduk was defeated and fled; Tibet was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the armies of Ga'erbi and Yensin entered Tibet in succession; Tsewang Donduk was defeated and fled, and Tibet was pacified.

sentences.zh: 上諭羹堯護凱旋諸軍入邊，召法喇還京師。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Gengyao to escort the victorious armies back within the border and summoned Fala back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Gengyao to escort the victorious armies back within the border and recalled Fala to the capital.

sentences.zh: 羹堯尋遣兵撫定里塘屬上下牙色、上下雅尼，巴塘屬桑阿壩、林卡石諸生番。

translations.literal: Gengyao soon afterward sent troops to pacify the dependent raw tribes of upper and lower Yase and upper and lower Yani under Litang, and Sang'aba, Linkashi, and other raw tribes under Batang.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao soon sent troops to pacify the raw tribes of upper and lower Yase and upper and lower Yani under Litang, and Sang'aba, Linkashi, and others under Batang.

sentences.zh: 六十年，入覲，命兼理四川陝西總督，辭，還鎮，賜弓矢。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he came to court for audience, was ordered concurrently to manage the Sichuan-Shaanxi governorship-generalship, declined, returned to his post, and was granted bow and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: In year sixty he came to court, was offered concurrent charge of the Sichuan-Shaanxi governorship-generalship, declined, returned to his post, and received bow and arrows as a gift.

sentences.zh: 上命噶爾弼率兵駐守西藏，行次瀘定橋，噶爾弼病不能行，羹堯以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ga'erbi to lead troops to garrison Tibet; en route at the Luding Bridge, Ga'erbi fell ill and could not continue; Gengyao reported this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Ga'erbi to garrison Tibet with his troops; at the Luding Bridge Ga'erbi fell too ill to continue, and Gengyao reported it.

sentences.zh: 上命公策旺諾爾佈署將軍，額駙阿寶、都統武格參贊軍務，駐西藏。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Duke Tsewang Norbu to act as garrison general, with Imperial Son-in-law Apao and Banner Commander Wuge as military advisers, to garrison Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appointed Duke Tsewang Norbu acting garrison general, with Imperial Son-in-law Apao and Banner Commander Wuge as military advisers, to garrison Tibet.

sentences.zh: 青海索羅木之西有郭羅克上中下三部，為唐古特種人，屢出肆掠。

translations.literal: West of Suoluomu in Qinghai were the upper, middle, and lower three divisions of Golok, Tangut people who repeatedly came out to plunder at will.
translations.idiomatic: West of Suoluomu in Qinghai lay the upper, middle, and lower divisions of Golok—Tangut peoples who repeatedly raided at will.

sentences.zh: 阿寶以聞，上令羹堯與鍾琪度形勢，策進討。

translations.literal: Apao reported this; the emperor ordered Gengyao together with Zhongqi to assess the situation and plan an advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Apao reported the raids; the emperor ordered Gengyao and Zhongqi to assess the situation and plan an attack.

sentences.zh: 羹堯疏言：「郭羅克有隘口三，悉險峻，宜步不宜騎。

translations.literal: Gengyao memorialized: "Golok has three passes, all steep and dangerous—suited to infantry, not cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao wrote: "Golok has three passes, all steep and dangerous—suited to foot soldiers, not cavalry.

sentences.zh: 若多調兵，塞上傳聞，使賊得為備，不如以番攻番。

translations.literal: If many troops are mobilized, word will spread on the frontier and the bandits will prepare; it is better to use tribes against tribes.
translations.idiomatic: If we mobilize too many troops, word will spread on the frontier and the enemy will prepare; it is better to set tribe against tribe.

sentences.zh: 臣素知瓦斯、雜穀諸土司亦憾郭羅克肆惡，原出兵助剿。

translations.literal: Your servant has long known that the native officials of Was and Zagun and other chiefs also resent Golok's wanton evil and are willing to send troops to assist in the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: I have long known that the chiefs of Was, Zagun, and other domains also resent Golok's outrages and are willing to send troops to help.

sentences.zh: 臣已移鍾琪令速赴松潘，出塞督土兵進剿。

translations.literal: Your servant has already instructed Zhongqi to hurry to Songpan, cross the frontier, and supervise the native troops in the advance.
translations.idiomatic: I have already ordered Zhongqi to hurry to Songpan, cross the frontier, and lead the native troops in the attack.

sentences.zh: 」尋，鍾琪督兵擊敗郭羅克，下番寨四十餘，獲其渠，餘眾悉降。

translations.literal: " Soon afterward Zhongqi supervised the troops, defeated Golok, reduced more than forty tribal stockades, captured their leader, and the remainder all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward Zhongqi led the troops, defeated Golok, took more than forty tribal stockades, captured their leader, and the rest submitted.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，羹堯密疏言：「西藏喇嘛楚爾齊木臧布及知府石如金呈策旺諾爾布委靡，副都統常齡、侍讀學士滿都、員外郎巴特瑪等任意生事，致在藏官兵不睦。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year, Gengyao secretly memorialized: "The Tibetan lama Chuerqimu Zangbu and Prefect Shi Rujin showed that Tsewang Norbu was slack; Vice Commander Chang Ling, Reader-in-Waiting Mandu, Department Director Batma, and others acted arbitrarily and caused discord between officers and soldiers in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In year sixty-one Gengyao secretly reported that the Tibetan lama Chuerqimu Zangbu and Prefect Shi Rujin portrayed Tsewang Norbu as slack, while Vice Commander Chang Ling, Reader-in-Waiting Mandu, Department Director Batma, and others acted arbitrarily, sowing discord among the garrison in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 」因請撤駐藏官兵。

translations.literal: " He therefore requested withdrawal of the garrison troops in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore asked to withdraw the garrison in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 下廷臣議，以羹堯擅議撤兵，請下部嚴議，上原之，命召滿都、巴特瑪、石如金、楚爾齊木臧布等來京師，遣四​​川巡撫色爾圖、陝西布政使塔琳赴西藏，佐策旺諾爾布駐守。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to court ministers for deliberation; because Gengyao had presumptuously proposed withdrawing troops, they recommended severe deliberation by the ministry; the emperor pardoned him, ordered Mandu, Batma, Shi Rujin, Chuerqimu Zangbu, and others summoned to the capital, and dispatched Sichuan Governor Se'ertu and Shaanxi Provincial Administration Commissioner Talin to Tibet to assist Tsewang Norbu in garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: The matter went to the court, which found Gengyao had overstepped in proposing withdrawal and recommended severe review; the emperor pardoned him, summoned Mandu, Batma, Shi Rujin, Chuerqimu Zangbu, and others to the capital, and sent Sichuan Governor Se'ertu and Shaanxi Provincial Administration Commissioner Talin to Tibet to assist Tsewang Norbu.

sentences.zh: 自軍興，陝西州縣饋運供億，庫帑多虧缺。

translations.literal: Since the outbreak of war, Shaanxi prefectures and counties had supplied transport and provisions on a vast scale, and treasury balances were largely in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war began, Shaanxi's prefectures and counties had supplied transport and provisions on a vast scale, leaving treasury balances deeply in deficit.

sentences.zh: 羹堯累疏論劾州縣吏，嚴督追償。

translations.literal: Gengyao repeatedly memorialized impeaching prefectural and county officials and strictly supervised recovery of shortfalls.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao repeatedly memorialized against prefectural and county officials and strictly supervised recovery of shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 陝西巡撫噶什圖密奏虧項不能速完，又與羹堯請加徵火耗墊補。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Governor Gashitu secretly memorialized that deficits could not be quickly made up, and together with Gengyao requested additional collection of surcharge silver to cover them.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Governor Gashitu secretly reported that deficits could not be quickly made up and, together with Gengyao, asked to levy additional surcharge silver to cover them.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「各省錢糧皆有虧空，陝西尤甚。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed: "Every province's tax revenues have deficits; Shaanxi's are especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor declared: "Every province's tax revenues show deficits; Shaanxi's are especially severe.

sentences.zh: 蓋自用兵以來，師所經行，資助馬匹、盤費、衣服、食物，倉卒無可措辦，勢必挪用庫帑。

translations.literal: This is because since troops were deployed, wherever the army passed, support for horses, travel expenses, clothing, and food could not be arranged at short notice and treasury funds had inevitably to be diverted.
translations.idiomatic: Since the war began, wherever the army passed, horses, travel expenses, clothing, and food had to be supplied at short notice with no ready source—treasury funds had inevitably to be diverted.

sentences.zh: 及撤兵時亦然。

translations.literal: The same was true when troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The same was true when troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 即如自藏回京，將軍以至士卒，途中所得，反多於正項。

translations.literal: Even on the return from Tibet to the capital, from the general down to the common soldier, what was gained en route often exceeded the regular quota.
translations.idiomatic: Even returning from Tibet to the capital, from the general down to the common soldier, what was gained on the road often exceeded the regular quota.

sentences.zh: 各官費用，動至萬金，但知取用，不問其出自何項也。

translations.literal: Each official's expenses often reached ten thousand taels; they took what they needed without asking from which account it came.
translations.idiomatic: Official expenses often ran to ten thousand taels each; men took what they needed without asking which account supplied it.

sentences.zh: 羹堯等欲追虧項以充兵餉，追比不得，又議加徵火耗。

translations.literal: Gengyao and others wished to recover deficits to fund military pay; when forced collection failed, they again proposed levying additional surcharge silver.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao and others sought to recover deficits to fund military pay; when forced collection failed, they again proposed additional surcharge levies.

sentences.zh: 火耗止可議減，豈可加增？

translations.literal: Surcharge silver should only be discussed for reduction—how could it be increased?
translations.idiomatic: Surcharges should only be reduced—how could they be increased?

sentences.zh: 朕在位六十一年，從未加徵火耗。

translations.literal: In the sixty-one years of my reign I have never increased surcharge collection.
translations.idiomatic: In sixty-one years on the throne I have never increased surcharge collection.

sentences.zh: 今若聽其加派，必致與正項一例催徵，肆無忌憚矣。

translations.literal: If this increase is permitted now, it will inevitably be collected as ruthlessly as the regular tax quota, without restraint.
translations.idiomatic: If this increase is permitted, surcharges will inevitably be collected as ruthlessly as the regular tax, without restraint.

sentences.zh: 著傳旨申飭。

translations.literal: Issue an edict of stern admonition.
translations.idiomatic: Issue an edict of stern admonition.

sentences.zh: 」命發帑銀五十萬送陝西資餉。

translations.literal: " He ordered five hundred thousand taels from the treasury sent to Shaanxi to fund military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered five hundred thousand taels from the treasury sent to Shaanxi for military supplies.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，召撫遠大將軍允還京師，命羹堯管理大將軍印務。

translations.literal: When the Yongzheng Emperor acceded, he summoned Pacification General-in-Chief Prince Yunti back to the capital and ordered Gengyao to manage the grand general's seal and duties.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongzheng Emperor took the throne, he recalled Pacification General-in-Chief Prince Yunti to the capital and ordered Gengyao to manage the grand general's seal and duties.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，授羹堯二等阿達哈哈番世職，並加遐齡尚書銜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Gengyao was granted a hereditary ada hahaan of the second class, and Xialing was given the honorary rank of Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1, Gengyao received a hereditary ada hahaan of the second class, and Xialing was given the honorary rank of Minister.

sentences.zh: 尋又加羹堯太保。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Gengyao was again made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Gengyao was again made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 詔撤西藏駐防官軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered withdrawal of the garrison troops in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered withdrawal of the garrison in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 羹堯疏陳邊防諸事，請於打箭爐邊外中渡河口築土城，移嵐州守備駐守；

translations.literal: Gengyao memorialized on frontier defense matters, requesting an earthen fort at the Zhongdu River crossing beyond Dartsedo, with the Lanzhou garrison commander transferred to hold it;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao memorialized on frontier defense, asking for an earthen fort at the Zhongdu River crossing beyond Dartsedo and transfer of the Lanzhou garrison commander to hold it;

sentences.zh: 大河南保縣，移威茂營千總駐守；

translations.literal: at Baoxian in southern Henan, transfer of a battalion commander from the Weimao garrison to hold the post;
translations.idiomatic: at Baoxian in southern Henan, transfer of a battalion commander from the Weimao garrison to hold the post;

sentences.zh: 越巂衛地方寥闊，蠻、倮出沒，改設游擊，增兵駐守；

translations.literal: Yuexi Guard's territory was vast and sparse, with Man and Luo tribes coming and going; establish a Mobile Brigade Commander post and increase garrison troops;
translations.idiomatic: Yuexi Guard's territory was vast, with Man and Luo tribes roaming it; establish a Mobile Brigade Commander post and increase the garrison;

sentences.zh: 松潘邊外諸番，阿樹為最要，給長官司職銜；

translations.literal: Among the tribes beyond Songpan, Ashu was most critical—grant the rank of head native official;
translations.idiomatic: Among the tribes beyond Songpan, Ashu was most critical—grant the rank of head native official;

sentences.zh: 大金川土目莎羅奔從征羊峒有功，給安撫司職銜；

translations.literal: Shaluoben, chieftain of Jinchuan, had merit in the Yangtong campaign—grant the rank of Pacification Commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Shaluoben, chieftain of Jinchuan, had merit in the Yangtong campaign—grant the rank of Pacification Commissioner;

sentences.zh: 烏蒙蠻目達木等兇暴，土舍祿鼎坤等請擒獻，俟其至，給土職，分轄其地。

translations.literal: Damu and other Wumeng tribal leaders were violent; native officials such as Ludingkun asked to capture and present them—when they arrive, grant native offices and divide their lands for separate jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Damu and other Wumeng leaders were violent; native officials such as Ludingkun offered to capture them—when delivered, grant native offices and divide their lands for separate jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 下部議，從之。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved.

sentences.zh: 論平西藏功，以羹堯運糧守隘，封三等公，世襲。

translations.literal: In recognition of merit in pacifying Tibet, for transporting grain and holding passes, he was enfeoffed Duke of the third rank with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in pacifying Tibet—transporting grain and holding the passes—he was enfeoffed Duke of the third rank, inheritable.

sentences.zh: 青海台吉羅卜藏丹津為顧實汗孫，糾諸台吉吹拉克諾木齊、阿爾布坦溫布、藏巴札布等，劫親王察罕丹津叛，掠青海諸部。

translations.literal: The Qinghai taiji Lobzang Danjin, grandson of Gushri Khan, rallied the taijis Chilaq Nomuchi, Albu Tanwunbu, Zangbazhab, and others, seized Prince Caghan Danjin in rebellion, and plundered the tribes of Qinghai.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinghai taiji Lobzang Danjin, grandson of Gushri Khan, rallied fellow taijis Chilaq Nomuchi, Albu Tanwunbu, Zangbazhab, and others, seized Prince Caghan Danjin in rebellion, and plundered Qinghai's tribes.

sentences.zh: 上命羹堯進討，諭撫遠大將軍延信及防邊理餉諸大臣，四川、陝西、雲南督、撫、提、鎮，軍事皆告羹堯。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Gengyao to advance in attack, instructing Pacification General-in-Chief Yensin and the ministers responsible for frontier defense and supplies, and the governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and garrison commanders of Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Yunnan, that all military affairs were to be reported to Gengyao.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Gengyao to advance against them and instructed Pacification General-in-Chief Yensin, frontier and supply ministers, and all governors, provincial commanders, and garrison commanders of Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Yunnan to report military affairs to Gengyao.

sentences.zh: 十月，羹堯率師自甘州至西寧，改延信平逆將軍，解撫遠大將軍印授羹堯，盡護諸軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Gengyao led his army from Ganzhou to Xining, changed Yensin's title to Pacification General, transferred the Pacification General-in-Chief's seal to Gengyao, and took full command of all armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Gengyao led his army from Ganzhou to Xining, reduced Yensin to Pacification General, transferred the grand general's seal to Gengyao, and took full command of all forces.

sentences.zh: 羹堯請以前鋒統領素丹、提督岳鍾琪為參贊大臣，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao requested Vanguard Commander Sudan and Provincial Military Commander Yue Zhongqi as military advisers; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao asked that Vanguard Commander Sudan and Provincial Military Commander Yue Zhongqi serve as military advisers; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 論平郭羅克功，進公爵二等。

translations.literal: In recognition of merit in pacifying Golok, his dukedom was advanced to the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in pacifying Golok, his dukedom was advanced to the second rank.

sentences.zh: 羹堯初至西寧，師未集，羅卜藏丹津诇知之，乃入寇，悉破傍城諸堡，移兵向城。

translations.literal: When Gengyao had just reached Xining and the army was not yet assembled, Lobzang Danjin learned this by reconnaissance, invaded, broke all the nearby forts, and moved his troops toward the city.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao had just reached Xining before his army assembled; Lobzang Danjin learned this by reconnaissance, invaded, overran the nearby forts, and marched on the city.

sentences.zh: 羹堯率左右數十人坐城樓不動，羅卜藏丹津稍引退，圍南堡。

translations.literal: Gengyao sat motionless on the city tower with several dozen attendants; Lobzang Danjin slightly withdrew and besieged the southern fort.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sat unmoved on the city tower with only a few dozen attendants; Lobzang Danjin drew back slightly and besieged the southern fort.

sentences.zh: 羹堯令兵斫賊壘，敵知兵少，不為備，驅桌子山土番當前隊；

translations.literal: Gengyao ordered troops to cut down the enemy stockade; the enemy, knowing the force was small, took no precautions and drove Zhuozishan tribesmen as the vanguard;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao ordered troops to storm the enemy stockade; the enemy, knowing his force was small, took no precautions and drove Zhuozishan tribesmen as the vanguard;

sentences.zh: 砲發，土番死者無算。

translations.literal: when the cannon fired, countless tribesmen died.
translations.idiomatic: when the cannon fired, countless tribesmen fell.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪兵至，直攻敵營，羅卜藏丹津敗奔，師從之，大潰，僅率百人遁走。

translations.literal: Zhongqi's troops arrived and attacked the enemy camp directly; Lobzang Danjin was defeated and fled, the army pursued, and he was routed utterly, escaping with only a hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi's troops arrived and struck the enemy camp directly; Lobzang Danjin fled in defeat, his army was routed in pursuit, and he escaped with only a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 羹堯乃部署諸軍，令總兵官周瑛率兵截敵走西藏路，都統穆森駐吐魯番，副將軍阿喇納出​​噶斯，暫駐布隆吉爾，又遣參將孫繼宗將二千人與阿喇納師會。

translations.literal: Gengyao then deployed the armies, ordering Major-General Zhou Ying to lead troops to cut off the enemy's escape route toward Tibet, Banner Commander Musen to garrison Turfan, Vice General Arana to advance through Gasi and temporarily encamp at Burungir, and Brigade Commander Sun Jizong with two thousand men to join Arana's force.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao then deployed his forces: Major-General Zhou Ying to block the escape route toward Tibet, Banner Commander Musen to garrison Turfan, Vice General Arana through Gasi to Burungir, and Brigade Commander Sun Jizong with two thousand men to join Arana.

sentences.zh: 敵侵鎮海堡，都統武格赴援，敵圍堡，戰六晝夜，參將宋可進等赴援，敵敗走，斬六百餘級，獲多巴囊素阿旺丹津。

translations.literal: The enemy invaded Zhenhai Fort; Banner Commander Wuge went to relieve it; the enemy besieged the fort and fought for six days and nights; Brigade Commander Song Kejin and others came to relieve; the enemy was defeated and fled; more than six hundred were beheaded, and Dobangsu Awang Danjin was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy attacked Zhenhai Fort; Banner Commander Wuge relieved it under siege for six days and nights until Brigade Commander Song Kejin and others arrived; the enemy fled after more than six hundred were killed, and Dobangsu Awang Danjin was captured.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津攻西寧南川口，師保申中堡。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin attacked the Nanchuan Pass of Xining; the army defended Shenzhong Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin attacked Xining's Nanchuan Pass; the army held Shenzhong Fort.

sentences.zh: 敵圍堡，堡內囊素與敵通，欲鑿牆而入。

translations.literal: The enemy besieged the fort; nangso inside colluded with the enemy and sought to break through the wall to enter.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy besieged the fort; nangso inside colluded with them and tried to break through the wall.

sentences.zh: 守備馬有仁等力禦，可進等赴援，夾擊，敵敗走，諸囊素助敵者皆殺之。

translations.literal: Garrison Commander Ma Youren and others defended strenuously; Kejin and others came to relieve; attacking from both sides, the enemy was defeated and fled; all nangso who had aided the enemy were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Commander Ma Youren and others defended fiercely; Kejin and others relieved them in a pincer attack; the enemy fled, and every nangso who had aided them was killed.

sentences.zh: 羹堯先後疏聞，並請副都統花色等將鄂爾多斯兵，副都統查克丹等將歸化土默特兵，總兵馬覿伯將大同鎮兵，會甘州助戰，從之。

translations.literal: Gengyao reported in successive memorials and also requested that Vice Commander Huase lead Ordos troops, Vice Commander Chakdan lead Guihua Tumed troops, and Major-General Ma Jinbo lead Datong garrison troops to join at Ganzhou in assisting the campaign—all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao reported in successive memorials and asked that Vice Commander Huase lead Ordos troops, Vice Commander Chakdan lead Guihua Tumed troops, and Major-General Ma Jinbo lead Datong garrison troops to Ganzhou—all were approved.

sentences.zh: 西寧北川、上下北塔蒙回諸眾將起應羅卜藏丹津，羹堯遣千總馬忠孝撫定下北塔三十餘莊。

translations.literal: The Mongol, Hui, and other peoples of northern Xining and upper and lower Beita were rising to join Lobzang Danjin; Gengyao sent Battalion Commander Ma Zhongxiao to pacify more than thirty villages of lower Beita.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol, Hui, and other communities of northern Xining and upper and lower Beita were rising for Lobzang Danjin; Gengyao sent Battalion Commander Ma Zhongxiao to pacify more than thirty villages of lower Beita.

sentences.zh: 上北塔未服，忠孝率兵往剿，擒戮其渠，餘眾悉降。

translations.literal: Upper Beita had not submitted; Zhongxiao led troops to suppress them, captured and executed their leader, and the remainder all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Upper Beita had not submitted; Zhongxiao led troops against them, captured and executed their leader, and the rest submitted.

sentences.zh: 察罕丹津走河州，羅卜藏丹津欲劫以去。

translations.literal: Caghan Danjin fled to Hezhou; Lobzang Danjin wished to seize him and carry him off.
translations.idiomatic: Caghan Danjin fled to Hezhou; Lobzang Danjin meant to seize him and carry him off.

sentences.zh: 羹堯令移察罕丹津及其族屬入居蘭州。

translations.literal: Gengyao ordered Caghan Danjin and his clansmen moved to reside in Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao ordered Caghan Danjin and his clansmen moved to Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 青海台吉索諾木達什為羅卜藏丹津誘擒，脫出來歸，羹堯奏聞，命封貝子，令羹堯撫慰。

translations.literal: The Qinghai taiji Sonam Dash had been lured and captured by Lobzang Danjin, escaped, and came to submit; Gengyao memorialized this; he was ordered enfeoffed as beile, and Gengyao was ordered to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai taiji Sonam Dash, lured and captured by Lobzang Danjin, escaped and submitted; Gengyao reported it; the court enfeoffed him as beile and ordered Gengyao to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 敵掠新城堡，羹堯令西寧總兵黃喜林等往剿，斬千五百餘級，擒其渠七，得器械、駝馬、牛羊無算。

translations.literal: The enemy raided Xincheng Fort; Gengyao ordered Xining Major-General Huang Xilin and others to suppress them; more than fifteen hundred were beheaded, seven leaders captured, and weapons, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep taken beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy raided Xincheng Fort; Gengyao sent Xining Major-General Huang Xilin and others against them; more than fifteen hundred were killed, seven leaders captured, and weapons, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep seized in vast numbers.

sentences.zh: 以天寒，羹堯令引師還西寧。

translations.literal: Because of the cold weather, Gengyao ordered the army withdrawn back to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: With the weather turning cold, Gengyao ordered the army back to Xining.

sentences.zh: 尋策來歲進兵，疏：「請選陝西督標西安、固原、寧夏、四川、大同、榆林綠旗兵及蒙古兵萬九千人，令鍾琪等分將，出西寧、松潘、甘州、布隆吉爾四道進討，分兵留守西寧、甘州、布隆吉爾，並駐防永昌、巴塘、里塘、黃勝關、察木多諸隘。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he planned the next year's advance and memorialized: "Request selection of nineteen thousand Green Standard troops from the Shaanxi governor's command at Xi'an, Guyuan, Ningxia, Sichuan, Datong, and Yulin, together with Mongol troops, with Zhongqi and others commanding separately, advancing by four routes from Xining, Songpan, Ganzhou, and Burungir; detachments to garrison Xining, Ganzhou, and Burungir, and posts at Yongchang, Batang, Litang, Huangsheng Pass, and Chamdo.
translations.idiomatic: He soon planned the next year's campaign and wrote: "Select nineteen thousand Green Standard troops from Xi'an, Guyuan, Ningxia, Sichuan, Datong, and Yulin, with Mongol troops, under Zhongqi and others by four routes from Xining, Songpan, Ganzhou, and Burungir; leave detachments at Xining, Ganzhou, and Burungir, and garrison Yongchang, Batang, Litang, Huangsheng Pass, and Chamdo.

sentences.zh: 軍中馬不足，請發太僕寺上都打布孫腦兒孳生馬三千，巴爾庫爾駝一千，仍於甘、涼增買千五百。

translations.literal: Horses in the army are insufficient; request issue of three thousand breeding horses from the Shangdu Dabusunao'er stud of the Court of the Imperial Stud, one thousand Barkul camels, and purchase of another fifteen hundred in Ganzhou and Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Horses are insufficient; issue three thousand breeding horses from the Shangdu stud, one thousand Barkul camels, and buy another fifteen hundred in Ganzhou and Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 糧米，臣已在西安預買六萬石。

translations.literal: As for grain, your servant has already purchased sixty thousand shi in advance at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: As for grain, I have already purchased sixty thousand shi in advance at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 軍中重火器，請發景山所製火藥一百駝，駝以一百八十斤計。

translations.literal: The army relies heavily on firearms; request issue of one hundred camel-loads of powder manufactured at Jingshan, each load calculated at one hundred eighty jin.
translations.idiomatic: The army relies heavily on firearms; issue one hundred camel-loads of Jingshan powder, each load at one hundred eighty jin.

sentences.zh: 」下廷議，悉如所請，馬加發千，火藥加發倍所請。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to court deliberation; all requests were granted; horses were increased by one thousand issue, and powder doubled beyond the request.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved all requests, added one thousand horses, and doubled the powder issue.

sentences.zh: 察罕丹津屬部殺羅卜藏丹津守者來歸，羹堯宣上指，安置四川邊外。

translations.literal: Subordinates of Caghan Danjin killed Lobzang Danjin's guards and came to submit; Gengyao proclaimed the emperor's intent and settled them beyond the Sichuan border.
translations.idiomatic: Caghan Danjin's followers killed Lobzang Danjin's guards and submitted; Gengyao proclaimed the emperor's intent and settled them beyond the Sichuan border.

sentences.zh: 墨爾根戴青拉查卜與羅卜藏丹津合力劫察罕丹津，其子察罕喇卜坦等來歸，羹堯令招拉查卜內附。

translations.literal: Mergen Daiqing Lachab together with Lobzang Danjin had jointly seized Caghan Danjin; his son Caghan Labtan and others came to submit; Gengyao ordered Lachab induced to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Mergen Daiqing Lachab had joined Lobzang Danjin in seizing Caghan Danjin; his son Caghan Labtan and others submitted; Gengyao ordered Lachab brought in.

sentences.zh: 又有堪布諾門汗，察罕丹津從子也，為塔兒寺喇嘛，叛從敵，糾眾拒戰，至是亦來歸。

translations.literal: There was also the kanbu Nomonhan, Caghan Danjin's nephew, a lama of Ta'er Monastery, who had rebelled and followed the enemy, rallied crowds to resist, and now also came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Kanbu Nomonhan, Caghan Danjin's nephew and a Ta'er Monastery lama, had rebelled with the enemy and rallied resistance; he now submitted as well.

sentences.zh: 羹堯數其罪，斬之。

translations.literal: Gengyao enumerated his crimes and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao recited his crimes and executed him.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津侵布隆吉爾，繼宗與副將潘之善擊敗之。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin invaded Burungir; Jizong together with Vice General Pan Zhishan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin invaded Burungir; Jizong and Vice General Pan Zhishan defeated him.

sentences.zh: 西寧南川塞外郭密九部屢出為盜，羹堯招三部內附。

translations.literal: Beyond the Nanchuan Pass of Xining, the nine divisions of Gomi repeatedly came out as bandits; Gengyao induced three divisions to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Xining's Nanchuan Pass, nine Gomi divisions repeatedly raided; Gengyao won three to submit.

sentences.zh: 餘部行掠如故，呈庫、沃爾賈二部尤暴戾。

translations.literal: The remaining divisions raided as before; the Chenku and Wo'erjia divisions were especially violent.
translations.idiomatic: The rest raided as before; the Chenku and Wo'erjia divisions were especially violent.

sentences.zh: 羹堯令鍾琪率瓦斯、雜穀二土司兵至歸德堡，撫定上下寺東策布，督兵進殲呈庫部眾，擒戮沃爾賈部酋，餘並乞降。

translations.literal: Gengyao ordered Zhongqi to lead the native troops of the Was and Zagun chiefs to Guide Fort, pacify upper and lower Sidongcebu of the monasteries, supervise troops in annihilating the Chenku division, capture and execute the Wo'erjia chieftain, and the remainder all begged to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao ordered Zhongqi to lead Was and Zagun native troops to Guide Fort, pacify Sidongcebu, annihilate the Chenku division, capture and execute the Wo'erjia chieftain, and accept the rest in surrender.

sentences.zh: 二年，上以羅卜藏丹津負國，叛不可宥，授鍾琪奮威將軍，趣羹堯進兵。

translations.literal: In the second year, because Lobzang Danjin had betrayed the state and rebellion could not be pardoned, Zhongqi was appointed Valiant General and Gengyao was urged to advance.
translations.idiomatic: In year two, finding Lobzang Danjin's rebellion unpardonable, the court appointed Zhongqi Valiant General and urged Gengyao to advance.

sentences.zh: 西寧東北郭隆寺喇嘛應羅卜藏丹津為亂，羹堯令鍾琪及素丹等督兵討之，賊屯哈拉直溝以拒。

translations.literal: Northeast of Xining, the lamas of Guolong Monastery had joined Lobzang Danjin in rebellion; Gengyao ordered Zhongqi and Sudan and others to supervise troops in suppressing them; the bandits encamped at Halazhigou to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Northeast of Xining, Guolong Monastery lamas had joined Lobzang Danjin; Gengyao ordered Zhongqi, Sudan, and others against them; the rebels held Halazhigou.

sentences.zh: 師奮入，度嶺三，毀寨十。

translations.literal: The army pressed forward vigorously, crossed three ridges, and destroyed ten stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The army pressed forward, crossed three ridges, and destroyed ten stockades.

sentences.zh: 可進、喜林及總兵武正安皆有斬馘，复毀寨七，焚所居室。

translations.literal: Kejin, Xilin, and Major-General Wu Zheng'an all took heads in battle; seven more stockades were destroyed and their dwellings burned.
translations.idiomatic: Kejin, Xilin, and Major-General Wu Zheng'an all took heads; seven more stockades were destroyed and their dwellings burned.

sentences.zh: 至寺外，賊伏山谷間，聚薪縱火，賊殲焉，殺賊六千餘，毀寺，誅其渠。

translations.literal: Outside the monastery the bandits lay in ambush in the valleys, piled firewood and set fire; the bandits were annihilated thereby; more than six thousand bandits were killed, the monastery destroyed, and its leaders executed.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the monastery rebels lay in the valleys, piled firewood, and set fire; more than six thousand were killed, the monastery destroyed, and its leaders executed.

sentences.zh: 青海貝勒羅卜藏察罕、貝子濟克濟札布、台吉滾布色卜騰納漢將母妻詣羹堯請內屬，羹堯予以茶葉、大麥，令分居邊上。

translations.literal: Qinghai beile Lobzang Caghan, beise Jikejizhab, and taiji Gunbusebutengnah sent their mothers and wives to Gengyao requesting to submit inward; Gengyao gave them tea and barley and ordered them settled separately along the border.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai beile Lobzang Caghan, beise Jikejizhab, and taiji Gunbusebutengnah sent their mothers and wives to Gengyao seeking submission; he gave them tea and barley and settled them along the border.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣鍾琪、正安、喜林、可進及侍衛達鼐，副將王嵩、紀成斌將六千人深入，留素丹西寧佐治事。

translations.literal: Gengyao dispatched Zhongqi, Zheng'an, Xilin, Kejin, and Bodyguard Datanai, with Vice Generals Wang Song and Ji Chengbin leading six thousand men in a deep advance, leaving Sudan at Xining to assist in administration.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Zhongqi, Zheng'an, Xilin, Kejin, Bodyguard Datanai, and Vice Generals Wang Song and Ji Chengbin with six thousand men deep into enemy country, leaving Sudan at Xining to assist in administration.

sentences.zh: 二月，鍾琪師進次伊克喀爾吉，搜山，獲阿爾布坦溫布，喜林亦得其酋巴珠爾阿喇布坦等。

translations.literal: In the second month, Zhongqi's army advanced and encamped at Yikeka'erji, searched the mountains, and captured Albu Tanwunbu; Xilin also captured the chieftains Bazhu'er Alabutan and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Zhongqi's army reached Yikeka'erji, searched the mountains, and captured Albu Tanwunbu; Xilin also captured chieftains including Bazhu'er Alabutan.

sentences.zh: 師復進，羹堯诇知阿岡都番助敵，別遣涼莊道蔣泂等督兵攻之，戮其囊素。

translations.literal: The army advanced again; Gengyao learned by reconnaissance that the Agangdu tribes were aiding the enemy and separately dispatched Liangzhuang Circuit Intendant Jiang Jiong and others to supervise troops in attacking them, executing their nangso.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced again; learning that Agangdu tribes were aiding the enemy, Gengyao sent Liangzhuang Circuit Intendant Jiang Jiong and others against them and executed their nangso.

sentences.zh: 复擊破石門寺喇嘛，殺六百餘人，焚其寺。

translations.literal: They again attacked and broke the Shimen Monastery lamas, killed more than six hundred, and burned the monastery.
translations.idiomatic: They again broke the Shimen Monastery lamas, killed more than six hundred, and burned the monastery.

sentences.zh: 鍾琪師復進次席爾哈羅色，遣兵攻噶斯，逐吹拉克諾木齊。

translations.literal: Zhongqi's army again advanced and encamped at Xi'erhaluose, dispatched troops to attack Gasi, and drove out Chilaq Nomuchi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqi's army reached Xi'erhaluose, attacked Gasi, and drove out Chilaq Nomuchi.

sentences.zh: 三月，鍾琪師復進次佈爾哈屯。

translations.literal: In the third month, Zhongqi's army again advanced and encamped at Bu'erhatun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhongqi's army reached Bu'erhatun.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津所居地曰額母訥布隆吉，鍾琪督兵直入，分兵北防柴旦木，斷往噶斯道。

translations.literal: The place where Lobzang Danjin dwelt was called Emunebulongji; Zhongqi supervised the army in a direct advance, detached troops north to guard Chaidanmu, and cut the road toward Gasi.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin's seat was Emunebulongji; Zhongqi led a direct advance, detached troops north to guard Chaidanmu, and cut the road to Gasi.

sentences.zh: 羅卜藏丹津走烏蘭穆和兒，复走柴旦木，師從之，獲其母阿爾太哈屯及其戚屬等，並男婦、牛羊、駝馬無算。

translations.literal: Lobzang Danjin fled to Wulanmuhe'er, then again fled to Chaidanmu; the army pursued, capturing his mother Altai Hatun and her kin, together with men and women, cattle, sheep, camels, and horses beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Lobzang Danjin fled to Wulanmuhe'er, then to Chaidanmu; the army pursued and captured his mother Altai Hatun and her kin, with men, women, cattle, sheep, camels, and horses in vast numbers.

sentences.zh: 分兵攻烏蘭白克，獲吹拉克諾木齊及助亂八台吉。

translations.literal: Detached troops attacked Wulanbaike and captured Chilaq Nomuchi and eight taiji who had aided the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Detached troops took Wulanbaike and captured Chilaq Nomuchi and eight rebel taiji.

sentences.zh: 時藏巴扎布已先就擒，羅卜藏丹津以二百餘人遁走。

translations.literal: By this time Zangbazhab had already been captured earlier; Lobzang Danjin escaped with only two hundred-odd men.
translations.idiomatic: Zangbazhab had already been captured; Lobzang Danjin escaped with only two hundred-odd men.

sentences.zh: 青海部落悉平。

translations.literal: The tribes of Qinghai were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Qinghai's tribes were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 論功，進羹堯爵一等，別授精奇尼哈番，令其子斌襲，封遐齡如羹堯爵，加太傅；

translations.literal: In recognition of merit, Gengyao's noble rank was advanced to the first degree, and a separate jingqinihafan was granted for his son Bin to inherit; Xialing was enfeoffed at the same rank as Gengyao and made Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: For merit Gengyao's rank was advanced to the first degree with a separate jingqinihafan for his son Bin; Xialing was enfeoffed at the same rank and made Grand Preceptor;

sentences.zh: 並授素丹、可進三等阿達哈哈番，喜林二等阿達哈哈番，按察使王景灝及達鼐、瑛、嵩、成斌拜他喇布勒哈番，提督郝玉麟及正安拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Sudan and Kejin were granted ada hahaan of the third class, Xilin of the second class; Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Wang Jinghao and Datanai, Ying, Song, and Chengbin were granted batulehafan; Provincial Military Commander Hao Yulin and Zheng'an were granted tuosalahafan.
translations.idiomatic: Sudan and Kejin received third-class ada hahaan, Xilin second-class; Wang Jinghao, Datanai, Ying, Song, and Chengbin received batulehafan; Hao Yulin and Zheng'an received tuosalahafan.

sentences.zh: 阿拉布坦蘇巴泰等截路行劫，羹堯令繼宗往剿，逐至推墨爾，阿拉布坦蘇巴泰將妻子遁走。

translations.literal: Alabutan Subatai and others intercepted the roads and plundered; Gengyao ordered Jizong to suppress them, pursued to Tuimo'er, and Alabutan Subatai fled with his wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: Alabutan Subatai and others plundered the roads; Gengyao sent Jizong against them, pursued to Tuimo'er, and Subatai fled with his family.

sentences.zh: 成斌等搜戮餘賊至梭羅木，擊斬堪布夾木燦垂扎木素。

translations.literal: Chengbin and others searched out and slaughtered remaining bandits as far as Suoluomu and killed the kanbu Jiamucanchuizhamusu.
translations.idiomatic: Chengbin and others hunted down remaining rebels to Suoluomu and killed kanbu Jiamucanchuizhamusu.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣達鼐及成斌攻布哈色布蘇，獲台吉阿布濟車陳；

translations.literal: Gengyao dispatched Datanai and Chengbin to attack Buhasebusu and captured taiji Abujichechen;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Datanai and Chengbin against Buhasebusu and captured taiji Abujichechen;

sentences.zh: 又遣副將岳超龍討平河州塞外鐵布等七十八寨，殺二千一百餘人，得人口、牲畜無算。

translations.literal: he also dispatched Vice General Yue Chaolong to pacify seventy-eight stockades beyond Hezhou including Tiebu, killed more than twenty-one hundred, and took population and livestock beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: he also sent Vice General Yue Chaolong to pacify seventy-eight stockades beyond Hezhou including Tiebu, killing more than twenty-one hundred and seizing population and livestock in vast numbers.

sentences.zh: 羹堯執吹拉克諾木齊、阿爾布坦溫布、藏巴扎布檻送京師。

translations.literal: Gengyao took Chilaq Nomuchi, Albu Tanwunbu, and Zangbazhab in cangues and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Chilaq Nomuchi, Albu Tanwunbu, and Zangbazhab to the capital in cangues.

sentences.zh: 上祭告廟、社、景陵、禦午門受俘。

translations.literal: The emperor offered sacrifices and reported to the temples of state, the altars of soil and grain, the Jing Mausoleum, and received the captives at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reported to the state temples, altars of soil and grain, and the Jing Mausoleum, and received the captives at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 羹堯策防邊諸事，以策妄阿喇布坦遣使乞降，請罷北征師，分駐巴里坤、吐魯番、哈密城、布隆吉爾駐兵守焉，轄以總兵，每營撥餘丁屯赤金衛、柳溝所田；

translations.literal: Gengyao planned frontier defense matters; because Tsewang Arabtan had sent envoys begging to submit, he requested disbanding the northern expeditionary army, dividing garrisons at Barkul, Turfan, Hami, and Burungir under major-generals, with surplus men from each camp farming fields at Chijin Guard and Liugou Post;
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao planned frontier defense; as Tsewang Arabtan had sent envoys suing for peace, he asked to disband the northern expedition, garrison Barkul, Turfan, Hami, and Burungir under major-generals, and set surplus camp men to farm at Chijin Guard and Liugou Post;

sentences.zh: 設同知理民事，衛守備理屯糧，游牧蒙古令分居布隆吉爾迤南山中。

translations.literal: establish subprefects to manage civil affairs, garrison commandants to manage colony grain, and order nomadic Mongols settled separately in the mountains south of Burungir.
translations.idiomatic: establish subprefects for civil affairs, garrison commandants for colony grain, and settle nomadic Mongols separately in the mountains south of Burungir.

sentences.zh: 寧夏邊外阿拉善以滿洲兵駐防。

translations.literal: Beyond the Ningxia border, Alashan was to be garrisoned by Manchu troops.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Ningxia border, Alashan was to be garrisoned by Manchu troops.

sentences.zh: 上悉從所請。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all requests.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all requests.

sentences.zh: 莊浪邊外謝爾蘇部土番據桌子、棋子二山為巢，皆穴地而居，官軍駐其地，奴使之；

translations.literal: Beyond the Zhuanglang border, the Xie'ersu tribal people held Zhuozi and Qizi mountains as their lair, all dwelling in excavated caves; when government troops were stationed there they were enslaved;
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Zhuanglang, Xie'ersu tribes held Zhuozi and Qizi mountains, dwelling in caves; government troops stationed there enslaved them;

sentences.zh: 兵或縱掠，番御之，盡殲，置不問，番始橫。

translations.literal: when soldiers sometimes plundered at will, the tribes resisted and were annihilated to the last man, yet nothing was done about it—the tribes then grew insolent.
translations.idiomatic: when soldiers plundered at will, the tribes resisted and were annihilated without consequence—the tribes then grew insolent.

sentences.zh: 涼州南崇寺沙馬拉木扎木巴等掠新城張義諸堡。

translations.literal: South of Liangzhou, Shamulamuzhamuba of Chong Monastery and others raided Xincheng, Zhangyi, and other forts.
translations.idiomatic: South of Liangzhou, Shamulamuzhamuba of Chong Monastery and others raided Xincheng, Zhangyi, and other forts.

sentences.zh: 又有郭隆寺逸出喇嘛，與西寧納硃公寺、朝天堂、加爾多寺諸番相結，糾謝爾蘇部土番謀為亂。

translations.literal: Moreover, lamas who had escaped from Guolong Monastery joined with the tribes of Nazhugong Monastery of Xining, Chaotian Monastery, and Jia'erduo Monastery, rallying Xie'ersu tribal people to plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Escaped Guolong Monastery lamas joined tribes of Xining's Nazhugong Monastery, Chaotian Monastery, and Jia'erduo Monastery, rallying Xie'ersu tribes to rebel.

sentences.zh: 羹堯遣鍾琪等督兵討之，納硃公寺喇嘛降。

translations.literal: Gengyao dispatched Zhongqi and others to supervise troops in suppressing them; the lamas of Nazhugong Monastery submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyao sent Zhongqi and others against them; the Nazhugong Monastery lamas submitted.

sentences.zh: 師進次朝天堂，遣成斌、喜林及副將張玉等四道攻加爾多寺，殺數百人，餘眾多入水死，焚其寺。

translations.literal: The army advanced and encamped at Chaotian Monastery, dispatched Chengbin, Xilin, and Vice General Zhang Yu and others in four columns to attack Jia'erduo Monastery, killed several hundred, many of the remainder drowned in water, and burned the monastery.
translations.idiomatic: The army reached Chaotian Monastery and sent Chengbin, Xilin, and Vice General Zhang Yu in four columns against Jia'erduo Monastery; several hundred were killed, many drowned, and the monastery was burned.

sentences.zh: 游擊馬忠孝、王大勳戰和石溝，王序吉、范世雄戰石門口，泂戰喜逢堡，蘇丹師次旁伯拉夏口，土番偽降，诇之，方置伏，縱兵擊之，所殺傷甚眾。

translations.literal: Mobile Brigade Commander Ma Zhongxiao and Wang Daxun fought at Heshigou; Wang Xuji and Fan Shixiong fought at Shimenkou; Jiang fought at Xifeng Fort; Sudan's army encamped at Pangbolaxiakou; the tribes feigned submission, he learned this by reconnaissance, and just as they were setting an ambush he unleashed troops upon them, killing and wounding a great multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhongxiao and Wang Daxun fought at Heshigou; Wang Xuji and Fan Shixiong at Shimenkou; Jiang at Xifeng Fort; Sudan encamped at Pangbolaxiakou; when tribes feigned submission he learned by reconnaissance they were setting an ambush and struck, killing and wounding a great multitude.

sentences.zh: 泂搜剿棋子山，逐賊巴洞溝，土司魯華齡逐賊天王溝，先密寺喇嘛縛其渠阿旺策淩以獻。

translations.literal: Jiang searched and suppressed Qizi Mountain, pursued bandits to Badonggou; native official Lu Hualing pursued bandits to Tianwanggou; lamas of Xianmi Monastery bound their leader Awang Celing and presented him.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang cleared Qizi Mountain and pursued rebels to Badonggou; native official Lu Hualing pursued them to Tianwanggou; Xianmi Monastery lamas bound their leader Awang Celing and presented him.

sentences.zh: 師入，轉戰五十餘日，殺土番殆盡。

translations.literal: The army entered and fought for more than fifty days, killing the tribal people nearly to extinction.
translations.idiomatic: The army fought for more than fifty days and nearly exterminated the tribes.

sentences.zh: 羹堯以先密寺喇嘛反覆不常，並焚其寺，徙其眾加爾多寺外桌子山；

translations.literal: Gengyao, because the Xianmi Monastery lamas were inconstant and treacherous, also burned their monastery and moved their people to Zhuozishan outside Jia'erduo Monastery;
translations.idiomatic: Finding Xianmi Monastery lamas treacherous, Gengyao burned their monastery and moved their people to Zhuozishan outside Jia'erduo Monastery;

sentences.zh: 餘眾降，羹堯令隸華齡受約束。

translations.literal: the remainder submitted, and Gengyao ordered them placed under Hualing's discipline.
translations.idiomatic: the remainder submitted and Gengyao placed them under Hualing's discipline.

sentences.zh: 條上青海善後諸事，請以青海諸部編置佐領。

translations.literal: He itemized post-pacification matters for Qinghai, requesting that Qinghai tribes be organized under zuoling.
translations.idiomatic: He itemized Qinghai's post-pacification measures, asking that its tribes be organized under zuoling.

sentences.zh: 三年一入貢，開市那拉薩拉。

translations.literal: Tribute once every three years; open a market at Nalasala.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute every three years; open a market at Nalasala.

sentences.zh: 陝西、雲南、四川三省邊外諸番，增設衛所撫治。

translations.literal: For the tribes beyond the borders of Shaanxi, Yunnan, and Sichuan, additional guards and posts were to be established for pacification and governance.
translations.idiomatic: For tribes beyond the borders of Shaanxi, Yunnan, and Sichuan, additional guards and posts were to pacify and govern them.

sentences.zh: 諸廟不得過二百楹，喇嘛不得過三百。

translations.literal: No monastery might exceed two hundred bays; no more than three hundred lamas.
translations.idiomatic: No monastery might exceed two hundred bays or three hundred lamas.

sentences.zh: 西寧北川邊外築邊牆，建城堡。

translations.literal: Outside the northern border pass at Xining, border walls were built and fortresses were erected.
translations.idiomatic: Border walls and fortresses were built beyond the northern frontier pass at Xining.

sentences.zh: 大通河設總兵，鹽池、保安堡及打箭爐外木雅吉達、巴塘、里塘諸路皆設兵。

translations.literal: A regional commander was posted at the Datong River; garrisons were also established at Yanchi, Bao'an Fort, and on the routes beyond Dajianlu at Muya Jida, Batang, Litang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: A regional commander was stationed on the Datong River, and troops were posted at Yanchi and Bao'an Fort and along the routes beyond Dajianlu to Muya Jida, Batang, Litang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 發直隸、山西、河南、山東、陝西五省軍罪當遣者，往大通河、布隆吉爾屯田；

translations.literal: Men from the five provinces of Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi whose military crimes warranted exile were dispatched to farm garrison fields at the Datong River and Bulongji'er;
translations.idiomatic: Convict soldiers from Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi who were due for banishment were sent to undertake garrison farming at the Datong River and Bulongji'er;

sentences.zh: 而令鍾琪將四千人駐西寧，撫綏諸番。

translations.literal: Zhongqi was ordered to lead four thousand men to garrison Xining and pacify the various frontier tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Zhongqi was ordered to lead four thousand men in garrison at Xining and to pacify the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 下王大臣議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the prince-ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was submitted to the imperial prince-ministers for deliberation and execution.
